v0.1.0-alpha.1: First pre-release of collectarr-sync — the desktop-to-server synchronization service.
v0.1.0-alpha.2:
• Drops the legacy `storage_box` sync field in favor of the renamed `location` field, aligning with the core backend rename.
• README refreshed with updated configuration examples and field documentation.

### ✨ Features

**Storage Box → Location Rename (#4)**

• Removed `storage_box` from the sync payload; the `location` field is now the canonical storage identifier.
• Updated sync logic and configuration to reference `location` throughout.

**Documentation (#4)**

• README updated with current field names, configuration examples, and setup guidance.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/collectarr/collectarr-sync/compare/v0.1.0-alpha.1...v0.1.0-alpha.2
v0.2.0: Localhost CORS is allowed in development, and the package version is aligned for release.
v0.2.1: Release container actions and sync dependency governance are updated.
v0.3.0: Stable Music-only personal-library synchronization and collection sharing. Core continues to own the canonical catalog; Sync carries personal library data and complete entry snapshots.
v0.4.0: Collectarr Sync synchronizes Comics library snapshots, keeping the catalog data together with personal grading, key significance and collection fields.

summary: Each signed-in account keeps its own library, and the first device to sign in moves the shared library into it.
A rejected account token is refused instead of falling back to the shared library.
The README describes self-hosting and links the current documentation.
